scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run start:dev -w backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w hardware-bridge && npm run test -w backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.dev:admin: npm run build:shared && npm run start -w frontend -- admin
scripts.dev:pos: npm run build:shared && npm run start -w frontend -- pos
scripts.test:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run test:unit -w frontend
scripts.e2e: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('frontend/.angular/cache',{recursive:true,force:true})" && npm run build:shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run e2e -w frontend
scripts.dev:bridge: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w hardware-bridge && node hardware-bridge/dist/main.js --dev
